WITH joined AS (
  SELECT p.death_country
  FROM all_star a
  JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT death_country, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM joined
  WHERE death_country IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY death_country
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) as total
  FROM grouped
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    g.death_country,
    g.cnt,
    CAST(g.cnt AS FLOAT) / tc.total as share
  FROM grouped g
  CROSS JOIN total_count tc
  WHERE tc.total IS NOT NULL
),
avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM with_shares
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    ws.death_country,
    ws.cnt as count,
    ws.share,
    ws.share - ac.avg_share as diff
  FROM with_shares ws
  CROSS JOIN avg_calc ac
  WHERE ac.avg_share IS NOT NULL AND ws.share > ac.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  death_country,
  count,
  share,
  diff
FROM filtered
ORDER BY death_country
